taste.name: Refração de verdade só onde há forma; blur no resto
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a material that needs to bend the content behind it on every browser, while real refraction costs far more than a blur
taste.decision: Chose an SVG displacement-map lens on two hero surfaces and a WebGL2 canvas for the showcase, and plain blur(12px) saturate(1.6) on the other 13 surfaces, over refracting everything or blurring everything
taste.reason: Because the eye reads depth from a few edges that visibly bend the scene; the rest only needs to separate from the background
evidence: 13 nodes with blur(12px) saturate(1.6) versus 2 with url(#lg-lens-...)
caption: Android and the web blur what sits behind
caption: A WebGL2 canvas that refracts a backdrop image

taste.name: Saturação e brilho levantados sob o vidro
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a pale surface that turns grey and dull once the backdrop is blurred
taste.decision: Chose to raise saturation (1.5 to 1.8), brightness (1.06 to 1.08) and contrast (1.02) in the backdrop filter over blur alone
taste.reason: Because blurring averages colours toward grey; boosting saturation restores the colour of the backdrop
evidence: background #FAF9F7 and surface #FFFFFF on 72.9% of the area
the only intense colour mass is the coral band behind the glass

taste.name: Sombra longa com spread negativo e filete de 0,5 px
taste.trigger: When the designers faced panels that must float over a pale page without a heavy grey halo
taste.decision: Chose a 1px ring plus one long offset shadow with negative spread (0 30px 80px -36px at 35%) for panels, and 0.5px inner rim lights for controls, over a symmetric blurred shadow
taste.reason: Because a negative spread keeps the shadow under the panel instead of around it, which reads as distance and not as a grey glow

taste.name: Restraint: um azul só e mola só onde há toque
taste.trigger: When the designers faced a showcase of 38 glass components that could each carry a colour and a motion
taste.decision: Chose one accent blue (#0067D9) on 0.2% of the area and one spring curve for the pressed state over per-component colours and ambient animation
taste.reason: Because glass already carries the backdrop's colour, and motion that only answers a touch keeps the surface still when the user is not acting
evidence: green #14A874 and red #B02D14 only in alerts
scale 0.32s overshoot curve only on buttons
